data.question: Is n*n+n+41 prime for every nonnegative integer?
data.objective: Find a checkable counterexample or establish what remains unproved.
data.context: Bounded arithmetic research example. Trial participant profiles are not live community accounts.
data.limits: Exact search through n=100; absence of a witness is not a proof.

data.title: Exact bounded search and factor witnesses
data.method: Evaluate the polynomial and seek an integer divisor by trial division.
data.qualification: One verified factor witness refutes the universal claim. A bounded search without a witness is inconclusive.

data.name: Primality of every claimed value
data.definition: A valid n>=0 and proper factorization of n*n+n+41 refute the universal claim.

data.statement: n*n+n+41 is prime for every integer n>=0.
data.scope: All nonnegative integers, not only a sampled range.

data.question: Can this sentence be shorter while preserving its meaning?
data.objective: Find concise faithful candidates and retain reader preference as a separate judgment.
data.context: Research progress should be recorded clearly so that people who were not involved can understand what was tried, see the evidence, and decide how to contribute.
data.limits: Three rewrites; word count is measured; model judgment is not human preference.

data.title: Meaning before brevity
data.method: Measure whitespace-delimited words, assess preserved obligations, then request reader preference.
data.qualification: Retain attempted work, newcomer understanding, visible evidence and deciding how to contribute. No automatic winner from word count.

data.name: Preservation of meaning
data.definition: Check all four stated obligations and reject added or reversed obligations.
data.evaluator: Attributable model assessment; human review still available.

data.name: Sentence length
data.definition: Whitespace-delimited words. Lower count is useful only among faithful candidates.

data.name: Reader preference
data.definition: Target readers compare eligible candidates with a reason; disagreement remains visible.

data.label: Original sentence
data.content: Research progress should be recorded clearly so that people who were not involved can understand what was tried, see the evidence, and decide how to contribute.

data.label: Rewrite A
data.content: Record research attempts and evidence clearly so newcomers can understand the work and choose how to contribute.

data.label: Rewrite B
data.content: Share research so anyone can help.

data.label: Rewrite C
data.content: Only experts can contribute after every research result has been verified.

data.question: Which revised question is worth testing after the counterexample?
data.reason: The original universal claim cannot stand after a valid counterexample.
data.expected_information: Distinguish useful restricted claims or revised formulas from the refuted universal claim.
data.prerequisites: Read the factor witness; agree a new scope before computing.

data.question: Does rewrite A preserve the intended meaning for the author?
data.reason: A model assessment cannot establish the author's interpretation or reader preference.
data.expected_information: Find any lost obligation before comparing style.
data.prerequisites: Inspect original, A and the recorded model judgment.

data.question: Which faithful rewrite do target readers prefer, and why?
data.reason: Word count cannot decide literary preference.
data.expected_information: Collect attributable preferences without erasing disagreement.
data.prerequisites: First resolve the fidelity review; then ask actual readers.
